input: Create files: /tmp/notes.txt with 'remember this', /tmp/data.csv with 'a,b,c', /tmp/script.sh with '#!/bin/bash'. Create a tar.gz archive /tmp/bundle.tar.gz containing all three files. Then list the archive contents. Finally extract only notes.txt to /output/ directory.

tool_calls: echo 'remember this' > /tmp/notes.txt && echo 'a,b,c' > /tmp/data.csv && echo '#!/bin/bash' > /tmp/script.sh && tar -czf /tmp/bundle.tar.gz -C /tmp notes.txt data.csv script.sh && echo "Files created and archived."
mkdir -p /output && tar -xzf /tmp/bundle.tar.gz -C /output notes.txt && echo "Extraction done:" && ls -la /output/ && echo "--- contents ---" && cat /output/notes.txt
